title: Run
description: One agent run, from the moment an item is claimed to the moment it stops. Go, Rust and TypeScript each assert their own type against this file, so a change here goes red in three suites until all three are updated.

item.description: The work item this run was claimed for

startedAt.description: RFC 3339 instant the run was claimed

tokensIn.description: Tokens sent to the model across the run

tokensOut.description: Tokens returned by the model across the run

costMinor.description: Cost in minor units, never a float
